title: Director, Plant Operations
text:
**When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.**

The Director of Plant Operations is responsible for the leadership and oversight of all facilities-related functions at Lahey Clinic, including the Burlington campus, Lahey Clinic North in Peabody, and multiple offsite buildings. This role manages a multidisciplinary team that includes skilled trades, the Grounds team, and the Safety Department. The Director ensures the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all building systems and infrastructure, and maintains full compliance with all regulatory and accreditation requirements. This position plays a critical role in supporting the hospital’s mission by ensuring a safe, functional, and responsive environment of care through effective facilities management, infrastructure planning, and team leadership.

**Job Description:**

1. Provide leadership and direction for all skilled trades, including electrical, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, painting, locksmithing, general maintenance, and grounds operations.

2. Ensure full compliance with all applicable regulations and standards, including Joint Commission, DPH, CMS, OSHA, and NFPA.

3. Oversee facilities operations at Lahey Clinic North and all offsite buildings, ensuring alignment with main campus standards.

4. Lead the development and execution of preventive maintenance programs, capital renewal strategies, and infrastructure planning.

5. Collaborate with hospital leadership, Design & Construction, and Environmental Health & Safety on projects, renovations, and upgrades.

6. Develop and manage annual operating and capital budgets; monitor expenditures and lead cost-effective resource use.

7. Cultivate a high-performing, service-oriented team culture focused on reliability, safety, and continuous improvement.

8. Serve as a key leader in regulatory readiness and response efforts related to physical environment, life safety, and utility systems.

9. Incorporates Lahey Clinic Mission Statement and Goals into daily activities.

10. Complies with all Lahey Health Policies.

11. Complies with behavioral expectations of the department and Lahey Health.

12. Maintains courteous and effective interactions with colleagues and patients.

13. Demonstrates an understanding of the job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment.

14. Demonstrates a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our customers and consistently adheres to Customer Service standards.

15. Participates in departmental and/or interdepartmental quality improvement activities.

16. Participates in and successfully completes Mandatory Education.

17. Performs all other duties as needed or directed to meet the needs of the department.

**Minimum Qualifications** :

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, or related field. Relevant experience may be substituted for the educational requirement.

Licensure, Certification, Registration:

* Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) required within 1 year of hire, or when eligible.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:

* Strong knowledge of building systems, life safety, and healthcare regulatory requirements

* Exceptional communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills

* Ability to lead teams across multiple sites and manage a 24/7 operation

Experience:

Minimum 7 years of experience in a healthcare organization, with at least 5 years in a facilities management leadership role

**Pay Range:**

$150,000.00 USD – $180,000.00 USD
